title: Ledger Clerk Note on Metal Market Repricings Kept on a Closure
content:
# Ledger Clerk Note on Metal Market Repricings Kept on a Closure

The repricings for the metal market booked to a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions are kept in part, kept in whole or not kept at all when the commission is closed at the customer's request. Which of the three follows turns on whether such a repricing stands booked and on whether the piece has gone into production.

## The shares

| Where | Kept |
|---|---|
| A repricing for the metal market stands booked on the commission and the piece has not gone into production | 40 per cent of those repricings |
| A repricing for the metal market stands booked and the piece has gone into production | The whole of those repricings, that is 100 per cent |
| Otherwise | None of the repricings for the metal market booked to the commission is kept |

A repricing for the metal market stands booked where the commission's entries under the metal market reason come to more than nothing. The piece has gone into production where the date production began stands on the commission, and has not where that date is empty.

## Readings (hypothetical)

With USD 1200.00 of repricings for the metal market booked to the commission:

- No date of production beginning standing on the commission: USD 480.00 is kept.
- The date production began standing on the commission: USD 1200.00 is kept.
- No repricing for the metal market booked at all: none of the repricings for the metal market booked to the commission is kept, whatever the production stage.
